The word 「弟」 (おとうと) consists of four moras (o-to-u-to). Its standard NHK/pitch-accent dictionary pattern is heiban (平板型, type 0): the first mora is low, pitch rises on the second mora, and remains high through the end of the word (おと́うと). No internal pitch drop occurs, and the contour stays high even when followed by a particle (おとうとが). This rules out atamadaka (initial drop), nakadaka (medial drop), and odaka (final-mora drop before a particle). No widely recognized variation to nakadaka exists for this lexeme in standard Tokyo Japanese.
